title: Brazil doctor uses surfboard and sledgehammer in flood rescue
html:
Brazil doctor uses surfboard and sledgehammer in flood rescue

A Brazilian doctor is being hailed a hero after rescuing an old man from severe flooding using a surfboard and sledgehammer. Rogerio Augusto Geremias managed to break into the sinking vehicle, allowing the elderly man to escape unharmed.
summary: A Brazilian doctor is being hailed a hero after rescuing an old man from severe flooding using a surfboard
